g.text: SYSTEM: 1 SICK
= ALL affected:
roles shift!
GENOGRAM IT
map 3 generations:
who? ill? close?
MEETINGS
deciders together,
one story!
BELIEFS: KLEINMAN 3
call it? caused it?
heals it?
NEGOTIATE
hospital + tradition
TOGETHER, safe!
SYSTEMS THEORY: family = system — one member ill → roles shift (daughter cooks,
son pays, wife decides!) → boundaries flex → beliefs rule ("asram, not malaria!"). Nurse
the SYSTEM: who does what NOW? who decides? who's breaking? (M03 carers!).
GENOGRAM (draw it!): 3 generations — squares/circles, ages, illnesses, deaths, closeness
(thick/thin/broken lines!), who lives where. 5 minutes, whole system visible — chronic +
genetic + mental-health cases REQUIRE it. Exam: "draw + interpret" — practise!
GHANA FAMILIES: extended + compound + matrilineal/patrilineal lines (Ashanti uncle decides!
— know WHO!) · polygamous + single + child-headed (AIDS/accidents!) · fostering (nephews
raised as sons!). Never assume nuclear — ASK ("who is family here…?").
FAMILY MEETINGS: gather DECIDERS (not crowds!) · one story, plain words · Kleinman beliefs
heard · options + costs HONEST · decision + date · document who agreed. Consent lives here
(PRO-I!). "Discuss with husband" = process — schedule the return!
BELIEFS → BEHAVIOUR: asram + teething · "cold" foods forbidden · blood fears ("drained!")
· CS = failure myths · mental illness = spirits · vaccines = infertility plots. NEGOTIATE
each (NUT/COM!): hospital + tradition together where safe; kindly firm where unsafe.
FAITH: pray WITH consent ("shall we pray before theatre?") · pastors/imams welcomed · fasting
+ drugs scheduled · dying rituals ROOMED (GER!). Faith + medicine, never versus.
MANTRA: "map the system, meet the deciders, negotiate the beliefs."
